description: Resolve named stops in multi-entity river rows where the compact source does not pair stops with countries. Each binding applies only within the named corridor. The country list is unordered.

sources.cshapes: WWO data/world_map/historical/cshapes_1900_snapshot.json, CShapes 2.0 snapshot 1900-03-12, intersected with the GeoNames settlement coordinates in gateway_positions.json. Only unambiguous matches among the listed historical units are used.
sources.peru: Municipalidad Provincial de Maynas, Ordenanza Municipal 008-2025-A-MPM, establishment of Iquitos as an Amazon river port in 1864. https://www.gob.pe/institucion/munimaynas/normas-legales/7379566-008-2025-a-mpm
sources.brazil: IBGE, Revista Brasileira de Geografia 51(2), historical account of the Belem–Manaus navigation line in Brazil. https://biblioteca.ibge.gov.br/visualizacao/periodicos/115/rbg_1989_v51_n2.pdf
